newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar sharply higher on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar sharply higher on fund buying.

text.p: CSCE March world sugar futures climbed to a five-month high of 11.22 on fund buying and a dearth of selling, floor sources said.
At 1317 EST, March was up 0.32 to 11.24, traded 11.24 to 10.89. Most-active May was 0.27 higher to 11.15 while the outer months were 0.06 to 0.15 firmer.
March reached a high of 11.30 cents Sept 24.

"Prices are going up on the perception of tighter supplies for delivery," Anne Prendergast, an analyst with Refco, said. She said Brazil's additional quota of 500,000 tonnes was suspended due to domestic demand.
"The funds are putting on fresh longs in March and no one is pricing," a broker said. "There is no resistanc in the form of any pressure.
